content.fact_text: A stag is a grown-up male red deer, and he grows a magnificent set of branching antlers that can stretch almost a metre wide! Each spring he grows a brand new pair, covered in soft, fuzzy 'velvet' skin while they grow.

checklist_log.source: wildlifetrusts.org (Red Deer wildlife explorer page) — confirms male red deer are called stags, describes their branched antlers up to one metre in breadth, and the soft velvet-covered regrowth process.
checklist_log.tone: pass - warm and admiring, no snark
checklist_log.predation: pass - omitted rutting battles and territorial fighting details from the source; focused only on antler growth, no predation, death, or threat framing
